messages.text: BL-1826 🎵 in progress — draftPathUnder's property draws path segments that may be ".." or "."; path.join then collapses the fake TMPDIR (or root) to "/", so the "never under TMPDIR" check fails for a correct draft path (seed -957004781, counterexample [" "," ",".."," "]) - the segment generators exclude dot segments, and every assertion stays
